title: MotionCore: A Latent Neural Simulator for Video Generation with Rigid-Body Dynamics
title_zh: MotionCore：面向具有刚体动力学视频生成的潜在神经模拟器

paragraphs.en: MotionCore引入潜在神经模拟器学习刚体动力学，提升视频生成的物理一致性。 Video generation models can produce highly realistic videos while generating physically inconsistent object motion. This limitation suggests that visual modeling alone may not provide a transferable representation of physical dynamics. We introduce MotionCore, a framework for learning physical dynamics via a learnable partial differential equation solver and focuses on rigid-body motion. We introduce a latent neural simulator learning to predict the evolution of object-level physical states from observed motion. Its predictions are then converted into spatially aligned latent controls for a controllable video diffusion model. The generator serves as a visual interface: it provides appearance and scene detail, while the learned dynamics model specifies the physical trajectory. To preserve this trajectory through the interface, MotionCore combines a diffusion-matching objective with a low-capacity decodability constraint on object identity and position. We evaluate MotionCore on public physical-consistency benchmarks and on paired data with known trajectories. Results indicate that MotionCore improves physical consistency and trajectory obedience in the evaluated rigid-body settings, while maintaining comparable visual quality. A controlled ablation protocol compares learned dynamics with an analytic prior and studies the choice of latent evolution processor.
paragraphs.zh: MotionCore 引入潜在神经模拟器来学习刚体动力学，提升视频生成的物理一致性。视频生成模型能够生成高度逼真的视频，但生成的物体运动可能不符合物理规律。 这一局限表明，仅依靠视觉建模可能无法提供可迁移的物理动力学表征。 我们提出 MotionCore，一个通过可学习的偏微分方程求解器来学习物理动力学的框架，并聚焦于刚体运动。 我们引入一个潜在神经模拟器，学习从观测到的运动预测物体级物理状态的演化。 其预测随后被转换为空间对齐的潜在控制信号，用于一个可控视频扩散模型。 生成器充当视觉界面：它提供外观和场景细节，而学习到的动力学模型则规定物理轨迹。 为了在该界面中保留这一轨迹，MotionCore 将扩散匹配目标与对物体身份和位置的低容量可解码性约束相结合。 我们在公开的物理一致性基准以及具有已知轨迹的成对数据上评估 MotionCore。 结果表明，MotionCore 在所评估的刚体场景中提升了物理一致性和轨迹遵从性，同时保持了相当的视觉质量。 一套受控的消融实验协议将学习到的动力学与解析先验进行比较，并研究潜在演化处理器的选择。
